Alongside 1-day delivery on all base MacBook Neo models from $590, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by these 15-inch Midnight M5 MacBook Air models up to $270 off and the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at $200 off. You can still land a AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off, but we also spotted Apple’s new AirPods Max 2 returning to Amazon all-time low pricing today alongside the official iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back at 40% off. Head below for a closer look at the details.

Amazon delivering all base MacBook Neo models as early as tomorrow from $590, still up to 2 weeks from Apple

  • MacBook Neo Citrus 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Citrus 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by Saturday

  • MacBook Neo Blush 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

These 15-inch Midnight M5 MacBook Air models are up to $270 off today

Amazon took things up a notch in terms of deal pricing on the new M5 MacBook Air lineup over the last few days or so. We are now looking at nearly $200 off select configs and, while pricing isn’t entirely reliable across the board, the best deals to date on certain models. However, B&H is getting rather aggressive again on some of the Midnight 15-inch models with deals at up to $270 off the list prices.

B&H has 3 specific Midnight 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations with official Apple charger upgrades (worth an extra $20), all of which are undercutting Amazon:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
  • With 70W USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)

And here’s a look at the closest configurations and the deal pricing at Amazon right now:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,449 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,500 (Reg. $1,699) – Amazon all-time low

While the 24GB/1TB is relatively similar in price at both retailers, B&H is offering the more powerful 70W charger for $1 less.

As for the other two configurations, Amazon doesn’t even sell a 24GB/512GB model and B&H is now dramatically undercutting Amazon on the 16GB/1TB even before you consider the charger upgrade. Amazon was offering the 15-inch 16GB/1TB at $1,300 yesterday, but that deal is mostly gone now and B&H is undercutting it by $50 anyway.

Amazon is, however, still delivering the best prices on the most affordable models though:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $900 (Reg. $1,099) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,300 (Reg. $1,499) – Amazon all-time low

Apple’s most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air just hit the Amazon all-time low at $200 off

Land a new set of Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 for the summer at nearly 25% off

Apple’s new AirPods Max 2 return to Amazon all-time low pricing today

While not all colors are back at the best price to date, we are now tracking a couple of Apple’s latest AirPods Max 2 treatments sitting back down at the Amazon all-time low.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Max 2 down at $509.99 shipped. While did catch a short-lived chance at the Midnight set for this price, that offer quickly jumped up to the $520 we have right now, leaving just the Blue and Starlight models back at the Amazon all-time low pricing.

While not a massive price drop from the regular $549 list price, this is as good as we have tracked since release on brand new condition units. There were some chances to score open-box units at Best Buy for slightly less than this, but with brand new condition units only $10 more at this point, you’ll likely just want to stick with the Amazon all-time low pricing here.

Apple’s H2 chip to support a series of enhanced features: a new amp, “elevated sound quality,” up to “1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation” than previous iterations, a Camera remote control, and you only have to say “Siri” instead of “Hey Siri.” A complete rundown of what’s new awaits over at 9to5Mac right here.

This deal also join the return of spring sale pricing on the most affordable AirPods 4 as well:

  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods Max 2 $510 (Reg. $549)

Most affordable new 13-inch M4 iPad Air hits Amazon low at nearly $100 off

We have seen more than a few chances to land the more pricey 13-inch M4 iPad Air models in the $100 off range, even as much a $110 off, the entry model though…not so much. However, Amazon is now offering its best price to date on the base model 13-inch at nearly $100 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 13-inch 128GB M4 iPad Air down at$699.99 shipped on all four colors: Gray, Blue, Purple, and Starlight.

This is a regularly $799 Apple tablet that released not much more than a couple months ago seeing a straight up $99 price drop for the lowest price we have tracked to date. We have seen this one in and around $50 off for quite some time now, but this week marks your first chance to land the new all-time low at just south of $100 off.
